rationale: The workflow already contains the dependency-cache optimization that the evidence supports: it caches ~/.m2/repository with actions/cache keyed on hashFiles('**/pom.xml') and restore-keys '${{ runner.os }}-maven-', matching P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE, so reapplying it would be a duplicate. Other candidates are not supported here: P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated because every non-experimental matrix job is a required outcome, so cancelling remaining matrix jobs would drop required checks, and its evidence is synthetic with negligible measured savings; P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks a representative measured baseline (ci_history is not_a_measured_baseline) and risks timing out valid slow builds on macOS/Windows; test selection/prioritization patterns would reduce intended build and test coverage, which must be preserved. No unrelated, privileged, or publishing changes are warranted.
